Guntur.trend_10yr: Stable with seasonal recharge response (+0.08 m/yr)
Guntur.limitations: District-level CGWB spatial extrapolation. Micro-watershed borewell lithology required for localized pumping tests.

Ahmedabad.trend_10yr: Declining (-0.45 m/yr) due to heavy agrarian and industrial extraction
Ahmedabad.limitations: High salinity in shallow coastal aquifers; deep saline ingress risk. Desalination and RWH mandatory.

Bengaluru Rural.trend_10yr: Severe long-term secular decline (-1.2 m/yr) in fractured hard-rock granite
Bengaluru Rural.primary_aquifer: Gneissic Hard Rock & Granitic Weathered Fissure Zone
Bengaluru Rural.limitations: CGWB mandates strict zero-fresh-extraction zone without 100% artificial recharge structures.

Jhansi.trend_10yr: Erratic recharge depending on monsoon deficit cycles in Bundelkhand granite
Jhansi.primary_aquifer: Bundelkhand Granitic Complex & Quartz Reef fractures
Jhansi.limitations: Low specific yield (1-3%). Check dams and percolation tanks essential to buffer drought years.

Pune.trend_10yr: Moderate recharge recovery during Western Ghats orographic monsoons
Pune.primary_aquifer: Deccan Basaltic Lava Flows (Vesicular and Amygdaloidal horizons)
Pune.limitations: Aquifer depth limited to upper 30-50m weathered zone; step-drawdown tests mandatory before site development.
